verdict.rationale: Omarchy is an Arch-based, open ISO installer supporting dual-boot alongside Windows (Quattro) and full-disk encryption, and community reports confirm successful installs on personal and work laptops, suggesting broad hardware compatibility without vendor lock-in. However, community evidence also flags install-script side effects (overwriting login managers, single-user design limitations) and supply-chain concerns (silent repo enabling), which are caveats to a clean 'any hardware, no lock-in' experience.
